title: Get a licence to run a market
what: Get the council's market licence before setting up or managing a market in Darwin; the licence holder then issues stallholder permits.

sources.title: City of Darwin By-laws 2023
sources.quote: Subject to by-law 107, a person must not, without a market licence, establish or manage a market in Darwin.

sources.title: City of Darwin By-laws 2023
sources.quote: The holder of a market licence may issue stallholder permits for stallholders to conduct business within the market.

sources.title: City of Darwin By-laws 2023
sources.quote: Subject to by-law 107, a person must not, without a market licence, establish or manage a market in Darwin.

reach.note: Market operation is not a listed ABS primary activity; Non-Residential Property Operators is the nearest class.

assessment.summary: Running a market needs the council's licence, open to bodies corporate in good standing set up to manage a market.

marks.reason: A licence open only to incorporated market managers, set days and times, and conditions.
